pages.title: Penrose Spindle
pages.text: A spindle built to couple with the ergosphere of a rotating black hole, the region where spacetime itself is dragged around so fast nothing can stand still. Penrose showed that energy can be extracted there by splitting objects. It spins freely and never seems to slow down.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A Kerr black hole wants to give away its spin. I built a neutronium spindle with a superconducting coil and a magnetic monopole at its core, so the frame-dragging could grip it and turn it directly.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Kerr Metric Shard, Penrose Ergosphere Generator.
